item.text:
Implemented in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx): the Server Component displays “Welcome” and uses Next.js’s `after()` to log page views after the response is sent. Dynamic rendering ensures logging runs for each request.

[lib/analytics.ts](/workspace/lib/analytics.ts) sends events to `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT`. Set that variable in `.env.local` to enable logging; setup is documented in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).

Verified the production build and confirmed that responses arrive while analytics is still pending. Analytics failures are caught and logged without breaking the page.
